name: G770 – Glowing Event Photo Gallery for Weddings, Clubs & Photographers
author: media770

sections.description:
After a good night everyone asks the same thing: where are the photos? With G770 you share them in a way your guests will love. They open one link on their phone, swipe through the pictures and save their favourites with one tap. No app, no account, no search through a huge cloud folder.
The gallery is dark, calm and made for party photos. Every picture gets a soft glow in its own colours, so your event looks the way it felt. It works just as well on a laptop.

Who is it for?

  • Photographers who want to give clients and guests a beautiful online gallery after a wedding, a birthday or a company event.
  • Nightclubs and discos that post the photos of a club night and want guests to come back for them.
  • Shisha bars, lounges and bars that host theme nights and want to share the best moments.
  • Event organisers and agencies for festivals, concerts, gala nights, company parties and trade shows.
  • Photo booth companies that hand out the booth pictures right after the event.
  • Private hosts who want one simple place for the photos of a wedding, a birthday, a graduation or a family party.

How it works

Your gallery is ready right after you install the plugin. Give it a name, drag your photos in, copy the shortcode into a page and share the link. You can also print the link as a QR code on the table cards or at the bar.
Guests see all photos in a grid and open any photo in the large view. They swipe left and right, swipe down to close, and on a computer they use the arrow keys. The back button of the phone works the way people expect.

Features

  • Download single photos in original size or as a lighter web version. File names are clean and easy to read.
  • Password protection. Guests type the password once and stay signed in for 30 days. You as the admin always have access.
  • Title and subtitle like the date and the venue at the top of the gallery.
  • Full screen mode that hides the header and footer of your theme, so the gallery looks like an app.
  • Your media library stays clean. Photos are saved in their own folder inside your uploads folder.
  • Upload in the browser by drag and drop, hundreds of photos at once. Big files are sent in small parts, so the upload limit of your hosting does not get in the way. Upload by FTP works too.
  • Fast loading. Small previews are made once and kept. The grid loads while you scroll.
  • Private by default. Gallery pages are hidden from Google and other search engines and are not cached. On Apache and LiteSpeed servers your original files cannot be opened directly.
  • Works with every theme, because the gallery runs in its own protected layer.
  • 11 languages: English, German, French, Spanish, Italian, Dutch, Polish, Portuguese, Turkish, Russian and Ukrainian. The gallery follows the language of your WordPress site, or you pick one.
  • No limits. As many photos as your web space allows, for as long as you like.

G770 Pro

G770 shows one gallery with all its photos. G770 Pro is a separate add on plugin for everyone who runs many events, like clubs, photographers and agencies:

  • Several galleries, and albums inside a gallery, for example “Photographer” and “Photo booth”
  • Your own logo in the gallery and on the password page
  • Watermark with your logo or a text
  • Folders by year, month and event, with a button that makes the folder for this month
  • Guests share photos to Instagram, WhatsApp, Facebook, Pinterest, X, Telegram, LinkedIn or by email
  • Download a whole album as a ZIP file, if you switch it on
  • Dark, light or automatic colours that follow the setting of each guest’s phone

You can get Pro in your dashboard under G770, Add Ons. G770 works fully without it.

Privacy

The gallery loads nothing from other servers. Fonts and scripts come with the plugin and photos are sent from your own website. A small “Powered by G770” link below the photos is off by default; you can switch it on in the gallery settings.
This plugin uses the Freemius SDK for an optional opt in and to offer the Pro add on. After you activate the plugin you can choose to share some basic data with us (WordPress and plugin version, site address, admin email) to help us improve the plugin, or you can skip it. Nothing is sent unless you agree or buy the add on. Freemius terms: https://freemius.com/terms/ and privacy policy: https://freemius.com/privacy/

sections.installation:
1. Install and activate the plugin under Plugins, Add New.
  2. Go to G770. Your gallery is already there.
  3. Give it a title and drag your photos into the upload field.
  4. Copy the shortcode [g770] into any page. Done.

In the gallery settings you can also add a subtitle, a password, the download size and the full screen mode.
sections.faq:
Can I use it for my nightclub or club nights?

Yes. Upload the photos of the night and share one link. If you post photos every weekend, G770 Pro gives you a new album for every night, folders by year and month and your watermark.

Is it a good gallery for wedding photographers?

Yes. Give the couple and their guests one link with a password. They can view and download the photos without an account.

Does it work for a shisha bar or a small private party?

Yes. It works for small events just as well as for big ones.

Do guests need an app or an account?

No. Guests only open the link in their browser and, if you set one, type the password.

Where are my photos saved?

In wp-content/uploads/g770/, in a folder with a random name. The exact folder is shown on the gallery page in the admin. The previews are kept in wp-content/uploads/g770-cache/. You can delete that folder any time, the previews come back by themselves.

Can I upload photos by FTP?

Yes. Copy the photos into the gallery folder and click Generate previews on the gallery page.

Are my original photos safe?

Yes. Photos are only sent through the plugin, after the password check, and guests never see file names. The gallery folder has a random name, so nobody can guess the address of a photo. On Apache and LiteSpeed servers the folders are also blocked completely. On Nginx you can add a rule that blocks /wp-content/uploads/g770/ for even more safety.

Will my gallery show up on Google?

No. Gallery pages are set to noindex, so the private photos of your guests stay out of search engines.

Does it work with caching plugins?

Yes. Gallery pages are left out of the page cache by themselves, also with LiteSpeed Cache.

How big can my photos be?

As big as your camera makes them. The upload is split into small parts. Guests see fast previews and only get the original file when they download it, if you allow that.

How many photos can I have?

As many as your web space allows. There is no limit in the plugin.
